name: Meeting to Execution
description: Turn meetings into explicit decisions, executable actions, reconciled project state, and verified follow-through.

tasks.name: Assemble meeting context
tasks.objective: Collect agenda, objective, pre-reads, prior decisions, open actions, constraints, and attendee roles. Identify what must be decided versus discussed.

tasks.name: Capture decisions and evidence
tasks.objective: Record decisions, options considered, rationale, dissent or uncertainty, commitments, unresolved questions, and exact material constraints. Do not turn discussion into a decision retroactively.

tasks.name: Convert commitments into executable actions
tasks.objective: Create one owner, deliverable, due date or trigger, dependencies, acceptance condition, and escalation path for every real commitment. Split vague multi-owner actions.

tasks.name: Reconcile with prior state
tasks.objective: Compare against prior decisions, plans, docs, and tickets. Flag contradictions, superseded decisions, duplicate work, and overlooked dependencies.

tasks.name: Publish concise record
tasks.objective: Produce decisions, action table, unresolved questions, parking lot, and evidence or pre-read links. Keep transcript detail out unless needed for accountability.

tasks.name: Close the execution loop
tasks.objective: At the next checkpoint verify completion evidence, update blocks, surface missed commitments, and explicitly close or renegotiate dates rather than silently carrying them forever.
